# Percentages - Practice Test - Year 7

Attempt all questions and show your working. Suggested time: 30 to 35 minutes.

## Section A: Consolidating (Questions 1-4)

**Question 1**

Write each number as a percentage.

(a) $0.35$

(b) $\frac{3}{4}$

(c) $1.2$

**Question 2**

Find:

(a) $10\%$ of 80

(b) $50\%$ of 64

(c) $25\%$ of 120

**Question 3**

Write $40\%$ as:

(a) a decimal

(b) a fraction in simplest form

**Question 4**

Find:

(a) $1\%$ of 350

(b) $5\%$ of 60

## Section B: Standard (Questions 5-16)

**Question 5**

Find:

(a) $15\%$ of \$240

(b) $35\%$ of 80 kg

(c) $12.5\%$ of 64

**Question 6**

Express the first quantity as a percentage of the second.

(a) 18 out of 72

(b) 45 out of 60

**Question 7**

Tran scored 34 out of 40 on a spelling test. What was his score as a percentage?

**Question 8**

Express 60 cm as a percentage of 2 m. (Hint: write both lengths in the same unit first.)

**Question 9**

Explain how to find $15\%$ of 60 mentally by first finding $10\%$ and $5\%$. Give the answer.

**Question 10**

A shirt normally costs \$48. In a sale it is marked $25\%$ off.

(a) How much is the discount?

(b) What is the sale price?

**Question 11**

In a class of 28 students, 7 walk to school.

(a) What percentage of the class walk to school?

(b) What percentage of the class do not walk to school?

**Question 12**

A gym membership costs \$80 per month. The price goes up by $15\%$. What is the new monthly price?

**Question 13**

Which is larger: $30\%$ of 70 or $70\%$ of 30? Show your working.

**Question 14**

The Hawks won 13 of their 20 games this season. The Eagles won 16 of their 25 games.

(a) What percentage of games did each team win?

(b) Which team had the better winning record?

**Question 15**

Use a calculator to find $17.5\%$ of \$386.

**Question 16**

In a survey, 250 students chose their favourite summer sport. $42\%$ chose cricket, $30\%$ chose swimming and the rest chose tennis. Copy and complete the table.

| Sport | Percentage | Number of students |
|---|---|---|
| Cricket | $42\%$ | (a) |
| Swimming | $30\%$ | (b) |
| Tennis | (c) | (d) |

## Section C: Advanced (Questions 17-20)

**Question 17**

A pair of headphones costs \$84 before GST. GST of $10\%$ is added to the price.

(a) What is the price including GST?

(b) The shop then offers $20\%$ off the price including GST. What is the final price?

**Question 18**

Jo scored 45 out of 60 on her first maths test and 52 out of 65 on her second test.

(a) Write each score as a percentage.

(b) On which test did she do better? By how many percentage points?

**Question 19**

A school has 840 students. $45\%$ of the students are girls. One third of the girls play netball.

(a) How many girls are at the school?

(b) How many girls play netball?

(c) What percentage of all students at the school are girls who play netball?

**Question 20**

The cost of a phone plan rose from \$40 per month to \$46 per month.

(a) Express the increase as a percentage of the original price.

(b) A year later, the \$46 price goes up by a further $10\%$. What is the new monthly price?
